text: The property lost 25.5 hectares of tree cover in 2015 due to a supported tree-cover loss event. This event is documented in the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13), which tracks stand-replacing tree-cover loss at a 30-meter resolution. The loss event in 2015 is one of several historical events recorded before the baseline date of December 31, 2020. The dataset indicates that there was no forest cover in 2020 according to the JRC GFC2020 V4 dataset, suggesting that the tree cover loss was not regenerated or replaced by the end of 2020.
